What should I do if the tracking never updates?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
If your tracking number never updates, this can happen while the courier processes the package. It may take a few days after the shipping label is created for the first scan to appear. 
What you can do:
Wait a few days after shipment for the first tracking update.
Check the tracking link regularly on the courier’s website.
If there are still no updates after several days, contact the courier directly with the tracking number to ask about the delay.
If tracking remains unchanged for 3–5 business days and the courier cannot provide information, you can reach out to our care team at care@nurosym.com so the situation can be reviewed further.
